paragraphs: Rabbi Abba’s father-in-law. He is mentioned in [Chullin 104b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.104b.11-12) in the phrase: “Agra, Rabbi Abba’s father-in-law, recited it — he recited it and explained it.” In [Menachot 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.29b.1) the leg of the ה of העם (in his tefillin) was broken through a hole; he came before Rabbi Abba, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Chullin distinguishes Agra’s recital of the teaching from his explanation of it. The broken letter story names Agra as Rabbi Abba’s father-in-law at the [end of Menachot 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.29a.19) and continues onto 29b.
